observation: Fresh main bound currentRunId and cycle ledger runId values to the durable RunStore identity grammar, but closure remained an opaque object. Runtime-generated closures carry runId, so a tampered closure could still claim an impossible run identity and weaken traceability.
changes: Validate closure.runId against the existing durable RunStore identity grammar when the field is present.
Publish the same optional runId constraint in Autonomous Mission v0.1 while leaving other closure metadata extensible.
Add a focused durable-read regression for valid, impossible, and runId-omitted closure objects.
